posts.title: AirviaTech and Wingie Enuygun Group join forces in travel technology
posts.excerpt: Türkiye's leading travel platform ENUYGUN.com selects AirviaTech's technology infrastructure for customized airline content through a single API.

body.text: Türkiye's leading travel platform ENUYGUN.com selects AirviaTech's technology infrastructure.

AirviaTech and Wingie Enuygun Group have entered into a new partnership in the field of airline distribution technology. As part of the collaboration, ENUYGUN.com will gain access to customized airline content through a single API via AirviaTech's next-generation flight distribution infrastructure.

The partnership also introduces a new B2B collaboration between the two companies. Through this cooperation, travel agencies using AirviaTech will be able to access Wingie Enuygun Group's global travel content.

As airline content becomes increasingly fragmented across the travel industry, online travel platforms are required to manage multiple technology providers and distribution channels simultaneously. AirviaTech's Aggregator Platform brings different content sources together under a single standardized infrastructure, enabling a more efficient, scalable and manageable distribution model.

One of the travel industry's key requirements today is the ability to manage different distribution channels through a single point of connectivity. ENUYGUN.com is one of the leading players in the industry, and its decision to use AirviaTech's infrastructure is highly significant for us as a reflection of the scalability and reliability of the technology we have developed.

Our goal is to provide our users with the broadest possible range of travel content while delivering the best possible experience. AirviaTech's flight distribution infrastructure provides us with important advantages in terms of operational efficiency and integration management. We believe this collaboration will make a positive contribution to both our technology infrastructure and the overall user experience.
body.cite: Orkun Özkan, Deputy General Manager – Flight Tickets, Wingie Enuygun Group

body.text: Today, AirviaTech brings together a wide range of airline and travel content providers under a single integration framework, including NDC airlines, GDS platforms, low-cost carriers (LCCs), charter operators and block-seat suppliers.

As an independent travel technology company headquartered in Türkiye, AirviaTech operates across multiple international markets, with a particular focus on Europe, the Middle East, Türkiye and the Turkic Republics. This partnership represents another important milestone in the company's journey towards becoming a global travel technology and distribution platform.
About AirviaTech

AirviaTech is a Türkiye-based travel technology company developing integration and distribution solutions for airlines, online travel platforms, travel agencies and corporate travel management companies. Through the AirviaTech Aggregator Platform, the company combines NDC, GDS, LCC and charter content within a single API and operates with the vision: "One API. All Airlines."
About Wingie Enuygun Group

Wingie Enuygun Group is one of the leading travel marketplaces in the MENA region, operating through wingie.com and enuygun.com. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of travel products, including flights, hotels, car rentals, bus tickets and transfers. Serving customers in 27 languages, Wingie Enuygun Group attracts approximately 200 million visitors annually.

posts.title: Turkish Airlines NDC application process & why you should choose AirviaTech as your aggregator
posts.excerpt: Direct NDC integration involves application, certification, testing and continuous maintenance. Here's how the THY process works — and the faster path.

body.text: Introduction

Integrating with Turkish Airlines (THY) using NDC is one of the most effective ways for travel agencies and OTAs to access richer content, more competitive fares and modern airline retailing capabilities. However, a direct NDC integration involves application, certification, technical testing, XML/NDC expertise and continuous maintenance — which makes it complex, time-consuming and costly.

This is exactly where AirviaTech, Türkiye's first and only IATA-certified NDC aggregator, comes into play. AirviaTech enables agencies to access THY content quickly, safely and with minimal technical effort.
1. How the Turkish Airlines NDC application process works
1.1 Submitting the official NDC application form
Turkish Airlines requires an NDC access application. In this form you are usually asked to provide:

items: Company legal details
IATA or non-IATA agency status
Expected transaction volume
Intended use (B2B, OTA, corporate travel, etc.)
Integration type (direct integration vs. aggregator usage)

body.text: Depending on THY's internal workload and your profile, the evaluation may take several days to a few weeks.
1.2 Receiving sandbox access & documentation

items: Sandbox (test environment) credentials
API documentation and technical references
Guidelines and sample flows for NDC integration

body.text: From this point on, your own development team is expected to build and maintain a full NDC-compliant integration.
1.3 The challenges of direct NDC integration

items: Expertise in XML / NDC schemas
Execution of mandatory test scenarios
Robust error and exception handling
System stability, version tracking and maintenance
An experienced development team and dedicated time

body.text: As a result, direct integration can easily become a long, expensive and risky project for many organizations.
2. Why choose AirviaTech as your NDC aggregator?
2.1 Fast access to THY NDC content — without certification

AirviaTech has already completed the necessary NDC certifications with multiple airlines, including Turkish Airlines, and is officially recognized by IATA as an NDC aggregator. You simply connect to AirviaTech's API once — and access THY NDC content through the same infrastructure.
2.2 One API, multiple airlines

items: Work with multiple airlines via a single integration
View and compare content from different sources in a unified API response
Significantly reduce operational and maintenance costs

body.text: 2.3 Technical complexity handled by AirviaTech

API stability, schema and version upgrades, error handling, ticketing logic and performance optimization are all managed by AirviaTech. Your systems simply consume clean, consistent and ready-to-sell airline data.
2.4 Faster time-to-market
While a direct Turkish Airlines integration can take weeks or even months, an integration via AirviaTech can typically be completed in a much shorter timeframe.
2.5 Dedicated support & operational experience
AirviaTech works with leading agencies and OTAs in Türkiye and internationally. Your teams receive active support during the initial integration, go-live and daily operations.
Conclusion

Applying for Turkish Airlines NDC is an important step. However, managing a full, direct NDC integration can be a significant burden in time, cost and operational risk. Partnering with AirviaTech, an officially IATA-certified NDC aggregator, removes most of that complexity and lets you start selling THY flights faster, easier and more sustainably.

posts.title: AirviaTech becomes the first IATA-certified aggregator based in Türkiye
posts.excerpt: AirviaTech has been granted "System Provider for Sellers" status under IATA's Airline Retailing Maturity (ARM) Index program.

body.text: AirviaTech Teknoloji A.Ş. has achieved global recognition by being officially granted the status of "System Provider for Sellers" under IATA's Airline Retailing Maturity (ARM) Index program.

This recognition marks AirviaTech as the first and only IATA-certified aggregator headquartered in Türkiye. The certification confirms that AirviaTech delivers airline content through a transparent, neutral and high-tech infrastructure that fully complies with IATA's global standards.

Being officially recognized by IATA not only validates AirviaTech's technical capability but also affirms our broader vision for the travel industry at an international level. Our goal is to help agencies move away from complex systems and instead focus on sales and customer service.
Who we are

AirviaTech is a next-generation and fully independent travel technology firm, founded to simplify and transform the airline distribution ecosystem. It operates with no agency or sales affiliation and is solely focused on developing technology infrastructure — offering a neutral, competitive and equal service to all travel agencies and stakeholders.
What does this mean for travel agencies?

items: One API, unlimited content: NDC, GDS and direct XML API connections consolidated.
Fast integrations: new airlines in weeks, not months.
Reduced development costs: AirviaTech handles all technical connections.
Workforce efficiency: technical teams are freed up so sales and operations can focus on the customer.
Real-time pricing and availability: dynamic fares, corporate rates, promotions and seat availability via a single API.

body.text: Where AirviaTech stands today

AirviaTech has already completed direct NDC or XML integrations with nearly 70 airlines in a short span, delivering all this content through one unified API — and continues to expand rapidly with new NDC, XML and charter integrations.
Strategic technology partnerships

items: Official member of the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program
Certified Technology Partner in the Amazon AWS Partner Network (APN)
